section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 12 ## Accidental Deaths by Sex The number of male victims under Accidental deaths was much more than females. The all-India average revealed 66.5 per cent as male victims and 33.5 per cent as female victims. The proportion for States was almost the same i.e., male involvement was 66.3 per cent and female involvement was 33.7 per cent but for Union Territories the involvement of males was higher, i.e., 74.0 per cent. Among metropolitan cities, percentage of male involvement was near the all-India average, i.e. 68.5 per cent and females involvement was 31.5 per cent.
